verified.exclude_domains: docs: parallel's own mapping, verified in contracts/search/parallel.json; the proxy forwards the field as sent (docs.litellm.ai/docs/search)
verified.country: docs: parallel's own mapping, verified in contracts/search/parallel.json; the proxy forwards the field as sent (docs.litellm.ai/docs/search)
verified.recency: docs: parallel's own mapping, verified in contracts/search/parallel.json; the proxy forwards the field as sent (docs.litellm.ai/docs/search)
verified.effort: live: tests/providers/test_litellm.py::test_live_every_effort_is_accepted (2026-11-12: Exa type=deep-lite and Parallel mode=advanced also changed the results)

max_chars_total.note: Top level: an upper bound on excerpt characters across all results.

fetch_policy.note: Under advanced_settings: max_age_seconds (600 or more), timeout_seconds, disable_cache_fallback. Cached content unless set.

client_model.note: The model consuming the results; Parallel tailors default settings to it.

session_id.note: Groups related search and extract calls, up to 1,000 characters; the response echoes it, or one the server made.

excerpts.note: Beta only; /v1/search rejects undeclared fields. Its successors are max_chars_total and advanced_settings.excerpt_settings.

max_chars_per_result.note: Beta only, deprecated there; on /v1 it sits under advanced_settings.excerpt_settings.

processor.note: Beta only, deprecated there in favour of mode.
